facts.fact: The NICI-III plan lists PSD Project 1 to establish a Technopole, a large-scale ICT park with science and technology incubation facilities, targeting incubation and R&D facilities by 2012 and 50 ICT companies operating in it by 2015.

note: as_of is the plan's published month, 2011-01, as the passages give no event date.
